locationWhy: Your position is only used to find your region, in the browser, and the weather, rounded to 10 km. It is never stored.
locationAbroad: You seem to be outside mainland France: national view.
locationCorsica: Corsica has no regional real-time data: national view.
locationRefused: Position refused or unavailable. You can pick a region from the list.
locationUnavailable: Position unavailable in this browser. You can pick a region from the list.
debugIntro: Every figure the scene uses, with its source and the time it describes. Field names are the APIs' own. Weather and sun are computed at the regional prefecture, rounded to 0.1°.
debugNoPoint: no reference point for the whole of France
sceneLabel: Pixel-art relief map of France. Wheel, pinch, arrows or + and − to zoom and move; Home to go back to the region.
plantsLoading: Power plants: loading RTE éCO2mix data…
plantsLive: Power plants driven by RTE éCO2mix, reading of {time}.
plantsStale: Power plants driven by an old RTE éCO2mix reading, of {time}.
plantsSample: Sample data: RTE éCO2mix reading of {time}, not live.
plantsReplay: Time-lapse: the past day in a minute, RTE éCO2mix reading of {time}.
plantsAhead: The RTE éCO2mix reading ({time}) is later than the time shown: the power plants are idle.
plantsUnavailable: RTE éCO2mix data unavailable: the power plants are idle.
